name: Lion's Mane
summary: Tooth fungus. Moderate fresh air, since too much air yellows the spines.
chamber_notes: If spines brown or yellow, cut fresh air and raise humidity slightly. Original Shrooly lion's mane recipe used a gentle fan ramp.

source_notes.title: Stamets
source_notes.detail: Paul Stamets, Growing Gourmet and Medicinal Mushrooms (commonly cited chamber ranges). H. erinaceus colonizes ~21 to 24 °C and fruits cooler, often 16 to 20 °C.

source_notes.title: Vendor cards
source_notes.detail: Published grow-card ranges from culinary spawn suppliers (FreshCap, North Spore, Out-Grow and similar). Lion's mane cards usually 85 to 95% humidity and 8 to 12 h light.

source_notes.title: Stock firmware
source_notes.detail: Shipped lion's mane LUA: 10 h photoperiod, 5% white LED, ramped fan over ~161 s.

stages.name: Pinning
stages.notes: Look for dense white primordia, not fuzzy overlay.

stages.name: Fruiting
stages.notes: Harvest when spines elongate but before they yellow.
